sloka: न दूतान् घ्नन्ति काकुत्थ्स वार्यन्ताम् साधु वानराः ।यस्तु हित्वा मतम् भर्तुः स्वमतम् सम्प्रभाषते ॥६-२०-१८॥।।
transliteration: na dūtān ghnanti kākutthsa vāryantām sādhu vānarāḥ ।yastu hitvā matam bhartuḥ svamatam samprabhāṣate ॥6-20-18॥।।

translations.english: "The envoy who puts aside the king's opinion and expresses his own opinion, which has not been said by the king ought to be killed."
